items.title: Tukaram Mundhe's FDA suspends licences of Blinkit, Chaayos, 5 Spice among 6 Mumbai establishments: What inspection found

The regulator said the breaches of food safety standards posed a public health threat.

The secretaries of the Department of Economic Affairs and the Department of Urban Development attended the meeting. The ministry's post gave no details of the proposals made by participants.
